title: Declaration authoring
description: Getting from nothing to a declaration that STEGO accepts: the scaffold STEGO writes, and the report that tells an author or an agent what it may declare at all.

title: Declaration checking
description: Deciding whether a declaration is acceptable, and refusing it in a way an agent can act on without a person reading the message.

title: Fleet knowledge
description: What each service was built from, recorded in the service's own repo and swept centrally, so a platform engineer can name every service that a component defect reaches.

title: Fix delivery
description: How a component fix travels from the registry to a service that already exists: digest pins, declared supersession with a date, and a fix taken as a bump and a new generation run.

title: Compiler trust
description: The operator installs a compiler they can trust: qualified at an exact commit, signed, and declared for a stated platform.

title: Build recording and regeneration
description: Apply writes the generated code and the record of what it was built from together, a reader checks that the two still agree, and a fix arrives as a pin bump and a new run.

title: Part authoring
description: A platform engineer writes a component: its config schema, the ports it requires and provides, the slots it offers, and the generator that emits its code.

title: Registry composition
description: Putting the parts together: a common registry that is trusted, a local registry that may add to it, and the archetypes that curate a golden path from them.

title: Part staging
description: Moving a component along the maturity ladder from alpha to beta to ga, and retiring one that reaches its sunset without graduating.
